name: 31522 · St Simons Is, GA
findings: ZIP 31522 (St Simons Is) has 96 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 31522 (St Simons Is) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 31522 (St Simons Is) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
